# doit_cloudconnect_gcp_connection (Resource)

Registers a Google Cloud organization, project or BigQuery dataset with DoiT Cloud Connect, so DoiT can read it through a customer service account it impersonates.

Use `doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements` to find the service account placement, the IAM permissions and the feature IDs for the scope. The API refuses the registration until IAM changes have propagated, which Google documents as typically 2 minutes and sometimes 7 or more, so wait after granting access in the same apply, for example with `time_sleep`.

~> **Note:** One Google Cloud service account can hold only one connection. A second connection with the same service account fails with `409 onboarding.connection_exists`.

Destroying the resource removes DoiT's record only; the service account and its IAM bindings stay in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connect a project with the core feature
resource "doit_cloudconnect_gcp_connection" "project" {
  scope_kind  = "gcp_project"
  project_id  = "example-project"
  feature_ids = ["core"]

  service_account = {
    email      = "doit-connect@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    unique_id  = "100000000000000000001"
    project_id = "example-project"
  }
}

# Connect an organization with BigQuery FinOps, storing its logs in the EU
resource "doit_cloudconnect_gcp_connection" "organization" {
  scope_kind      = "gcp_organization"
  organization_id = "123456789012"
  feature_ids     = ["core", "bigquery-finops"]

  service_account = {
    email      = "doit-connect@example-admin-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    unique_id  = "100000000000000000002"
    project_id = "example-admin-project"
  }

  feature_inputs = {
    bigquery_finops = {
      location = "EU"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `feature_ids` (Set of String) Cloud Connect features to enable. Valid IDs depend on the customer and the scope; `doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements` lists them.
- `scope_kind` (String) Google Cloud resource the connection grants access to: `gcp_organization`, `gcp_project` or `gcp_dataset`. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `service_account` (Attributes) The customer's Google Cloud service account that DoiT impersonates. One service account can hold only one connection. Changing it replaces the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_account))

### Optional

- `catalog_version` (String) Catalog version from `doit_cloudconnect_gcp_requirements`. When set, the API refuses the change if the feature catalog changed since. When omitted, the provider stores the version the API recorded.
- `dataset_id` (String) BigQuery dataset ID. Required when `scope_kind` is `gcp_dataset`. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `feature_inputs` (Attributes) Inputs of features that need them. Omit it to use the API defaults; removing it clears the stored inputs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_inputs))
- `organization_id` (String) Numeric Google Cloud organization ID. Required when `scope_kind` is `gcp_organization`. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `project_id` (String) Google Cloud project ID. Required when `scope_kind` is `gcp_project` or `gcp_dataset`. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the custom IAM role created for the connection. Defaults to `doit_cmp_role` for an organization or project and to a dataset role for a dataset. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `baseline_checks` (Attributes) Latest background health check status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--baseline_checks))
- `binding_id` (String) Key that relates `follow_ups` entries to this connection.
- `client_user_agent` (String) User-Agent of the client that last changed the connection.
- `etag` (String) Current ETag of the connection. The provider sends it with updates and deletes to detect changes made outside Terraform.
- `feature_verification` (Attributes) Summary of the last synchronous verification check recorded on the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_verification))
- `follow_ups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--follow_ups))
- `id` (String) The ID of the connection.
- `registered_via` (String) How the connection was registered: `api`, `console` or `cloudformation_callback`.
- `registration` (Attributes) Registration status of the connection record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registration))
- `revision` (String) Configuration revision of the connection.

### Nested Schema for `service_account`

Required:

- `email` (String) Customer service account email.
- `project_id` (String) Google Cloud project hosting the service account.
- `unique_id` (String) Immutable numeric Google service account unique ID.


<a id="nestedatt--feature_inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature_inputs`

Optional:

- `bigquery_finops` (Attributes) Inputs of the `bigquery-finops` feature. Requires `bigquery-finops` in `feature_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_inputs--bigquery_finops))

<a id="nestedatt--feature_inputs--bigquery_finops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature_inputs.bigquery_finops`

Optional:

- `location` (String) BigQuery location where the FinOps log-sink dataset is created (defaults to `US`). Validated server-side against the active catalog's supported BigQuery locations; pass `null` on `PATCH` to clear the override.



<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import doit_cloudconnect_gcp_connection.project google-cloud-100000000000000000001
```
